'''Glowzees''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of bioluminescent flying [[Insect/Legends|insects]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
Glowzees were dynamic creatures in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role playing-game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
